specimen: Reef cartographer, plates on a diagonally turning and tapering swimming tail
reproduction: Apply the operations to the original form with character-view/variations.js applyOperations or a workshop proposal. The test verified the replay equals the measured 33-part form, including 21 plate regions.
Export Game with the rig enabled. Name the new GLB reef-tail.glb.

To reproduce the distal joint: python scripts/measure-garments.py reef-tail.glb --contact "tail plate 7.2" tail --samples 6. For the full check, repeat --contact for every row 1..7 and column 1..3 (IDs tail plate ROW.COLUMN).

method.contact: Count a plate/carrier pair once if any child triangle intersects its parent mesh, using the exported skinned GLB and its _REGION triangles. Rest plus phases 0, 1/6, 2/6, 3/6, 4/6, 5/6 of Idle, Walk, Crouch, Reach, Fly and Swim.

shapeReference.bounds: Maximum absolute difference among six axis-aligned bounds of the posed tail region in Swim phase 0.
shapeReference.silhouette: Intersection over union of full-detail and game binary masks in a lower-body crop. 700 x 440, 0.86 m orthographic vertical span, target [0.25,0.355,-0.18] m, pitch 14 degrees, yaw -100/110/160 degrees. Both are posed in Swim phase 0.

distalJoint.distanceMethod: Minimum distance between the 58 child and 260 carrier triangles in the original game mesh. Evaluated vertex-to-face and edge-to-edge distances.
distalJoint.visibility: The original gap measures about 0.12 pixels at this inspection crop. Separated contact is measurable but not reliably distinguishable at game size.

solution: Keep the plate socket and its matching carrier triangles in the reduced mesh. Retain six angles around every sweep ring of plated tails and axial spines, including the free tip. A socket-only prototype with matching carrier triangles restored intersection but shortened the tail by up to 128 mm. The accepted version preserves its curved outline.
limits: Contact is checked at the sampled phases. It does not establish continuous contact, lack of penetration, or lack of plate-to-plate collision on other carriers.
